note: Four confirmed 96-channel M1-only Indy sessions from O'Doherty/Cardoso/Makin/Sabes 2020 (Zenodo 3854034), selected 2026-08-30: 1.77 GB, 285,359 bins at 20 ms, calendar span 2016-06-24 to 2016-09-15. Per the record: 'in most sessions M1 recordings were made alone (96 channels)'. Two previously-listed April 2016 sessions were dropped as 192-channel M1+S1 (see dropped_sessions). sha256 is the reproducibility pin, computed and written back by scripts/download_indy.py on the first verified fetch; size_bytes and zenodo_md5 are the publisher-side transport cross-checks used BEFORE the sha256 is trusted, and zenodo_md5 is NOT a security control (md5 has no collision resistance). The loader (ndt1.data.load_session) enforces width == CORTEX_CHANNEL_COUNT (96) at load time and raises ValueError on a 192-channel file - that is the runtime gate; this manifest is the reproducibility record.

dropped_sessions.reason: 192-channel M1+S1 recording (chan_names run 'M1 001' .. 'S1 096'); ndt1.data.load_session correctly rejects it against CORTEX_CHANNEL_COUNT=96
